features.name: Church, Blairdaff
features.fullDescription: Opened 9/6/1839. Gothick, design based on parish church, but centre parts of gables advanced and pinnacles at bellcote. Pinned red granite, original glazing, (formerly) piend roofed session house northeast wall (2021). U-plan gallery, original pulpit with sounding board.
